newsitem.title: USA: BP gets initial EPA ok for Ohio plant upgrade.
newsitem.headline: BP gets initial EPA ok for Ohio plant upgrade.

text.p: British Petroleum received a preliminary permit Wednesday from state environmental officials for a proposed $235 million upgrade of its Toledo, Ohio refinery.

The draft permit given by the Ohio Environmental Protection Agency now puts the company's proposed alterations at the 155,000 barrel per day (bpd) capacity refinery up for public debate, according to officials at the agency.
A public hearing on the upgrades has been tenatively set for March 27, one state EPA official said.

BP is seeking to boost inputs of sour crude at the refinery to about 75 percent of the total crude runs, according to company officials, up from less than 20 percent currently. Sweet crude inputs would be cut to about 25 percent under the upgrade.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
